_about: Validator fixture, not game data: a copy of the real KAI file, in the D1a shape.
_brinkLimbs: the brink: the core broken, or this many of head, arms and legs broken (the stricter brink, spec section 1b; was 2)
_wearPerDamage: k 0.038 x 6000 (Game Design's interim value with the stricter brink, spec section 1b)
_act1Damping: wear x this while the act index is 1 (act = 1 + region breaks so far, both fighters; M1 will own the act)

overtime._note: k x min(cap, 1 + perMin x minutes past start). Candidate A (default): 28800 ticks (8:00), 0.25. Candidate B: 30600 ticks (8:30), 0.40. QA picks by editing both fighters' files

fade._note: per tick: out 0.25/s below 60 out of exchanges; breath 1/s for battered regions after 240 ticks without an exchange, down to hiddenFloor (59; pinned: sim/director/ai.gd); hidden 3/s with the hiding kit

family._note: region pick weights (head, core, arms, legs) by hit family

penalties._note: S3a and S3b stage penalties. headParryNarrow (sim/director/melee.gd), headDefence and legsSlip (sim/director/data.gd) are pinned

rally._note: a mended region returns battered at 89; 15 s between Rallies
